scenarios.caption: Mirror, frame counter
scenarios.purpose: Source-unique frame rate and pacing when every display refresh changes the screen (Mirror).

steps.instruction: Turn on Streaming Diagnostics on this Mac and on the receiving device (iPhone/iPad: Settings > Diagnostics > Streaming Diagnostics).
Write down the conditions the app cannot see: sender power source and display refresh, receiver model and OS, network, other running apps. Keep them the same for every trial.
Click Open Fixture Window and move the fixture onto the streamed display. Make it fill that display (Zoom), unless the scenario says otherwise.
Optional, for exact frame-ID counts: turn on the experimental Metal renderer on the receiver. It changes presentation timing, so record it and use the same setting for every run you compare.
Start a Mirror session to the receiving device.
Keep hands off both devices while the trial measures.
